comment: Encounter-wide authored values, shared by every encounter (K14). The player body is sized independently of any enemy (G08). Per-encounter values (rulesVersion, displayName, primaryArchetype, spawns, session) live under encounters. The player body is the symmetric 5 x 7 body core: 0.556 x 0.778 tiles (5/9 and 7/9), using the approved beveled octagon with no lateral arm bump. The V11 Paladin hull and its supersession are recorded in docs/player-body-source.md.

presentation.comment: Trainer-authored, not sourced: how long a lob's detonation circle is telegraphed before it goes off.

spawns.comment: A single worm at t=0, never repeated (DC-V24-5, plan V24). ringRadiusFraction 0.84375 now places it 0.84375 * 8.645 = 7.29421875 tiles from the centre (DC-V24-6); goldenAngleDegrees has no effect with one worm.

killer-bee-queen.playerSpawnComment: User decision 2026-11-19: the player starts 45 degrees from the Queen (who spawns at the centre), midway across the walkable band between the centre honey diamond (halfDiagonalTiles 3.5, so 1.75 * sqrt 2 = 2.475 tiles out along 45 degrees) and the honey annulus (innerRadiusTiles 7.5): (2.475 + 7.5) / 2 = 4.987 tiles, which is 3.527 tiles on each axis.

spawns.comment: K10: a single boss, not a swarm. One enemy at t=0 and never again - everySeconds null means the periodic schedule never repeats. P40: arena-center replaces farthest-from-player so she no longer walks in from 16.2 tiles out during a phase-3 drill; her phase-3 move-to-point movement stays authored as-is and is now a no-op at spawn.
